explain: /27 ka block size 256-224 = 32 hai, blocks 0/32/64/96. 75 block 64-95 mein girta hai, to network address 192.168.10.64 hai.

q: /27 subnet mein kitne usable hosts hote hain?
explain: /27 mein 5 host bits hain, usable hosts = 2^5 - 2 = 30 (network aur broadcast address chhodke).

q: In mein se kaun sa IP private (RFC 1918) nahi hai?
explain: Private 172 range sirf 172.16.0.0 se 172.31.255.255 tak hai, isliye 172.32.0.1 public hai.

q: Agar ek subnet mein kam se kam 50 hosts chahiye, to sabse chhota sahi prefix kaun sa hai?
explain: /26 mein 2^6 - 2 = 62 usable hosts hain, jo 50 ke liye kaafi aur sabse chhota (tight) fit hai.

q: IPv6 address 2001:0db8:0000:0000:0000:ff00:0042:8329 ka sabse chhota (compressed) form kya hai?
explain: Leading zeros hatao aur all-zero groups ke run ko ek baar :: se replace karo: 2001:db8::ff00:42:8329.
